'''2007 California State Championship Nick Seistrup DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Seistrup]] at [[2007 California State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
